thought.text: The token was simply expired (Keycloak default access token lifetime is 60s). Let me get a fresh token and retest immediately.

reasoning_content:
The token was expired (Keycloak's default access token lifetime is short, 60 seconds). Let's fetch a new token and retry. This explains the 401 — the token was expired at the time of the test.

Let's obtain a new user token and test again.

action.command:
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "client_id=strassennamen" -d "grant_type=password" -d "username=user1" -d "password=user1pass" | jq -r .access_token > /tmp/user-token.txt
UTOK=$(cat /tmp/user-token.txt)
echo "=== no token (expect 401) ==="
curl -s --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse?skip=0&take=1"
echo "=== with fresh valid token (expect 200) ==="
curl -s --max-time 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $UTOK" "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse?skip=0&take=1" -o /tmp/strasse-resp.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"
head -c 300 /tmp/strasse-resp.json
